findings.issue: CSP img-src rejected blob URLs, so actual local file preview stayed blank. Header-only mocks did not catch it.
findings.fix: Root added blob: only to img-src; script-src retained restrictions.

findings.issue: Appearance revision Use buttons stayed disabled after activation because the asset list rendered while charactersBusy was true and was not refreshed when busy ended.
findings.fix: Frontend refreshes appearance controls when busy changes and retains current-revision guard; regression added.
findings.state: fixed and actual Chromium rollback reverified

findings.issue: Legacy names accepted by the old application can exceed the new catalog limit or contain control characters, preventing migrated initialization.
findings.fix: Root normalizes only migrated-copy name to safe catalog name and logs audit, retaining original legacy source.
findings.state: fixed and actual HTTP plus SHA256 preservation reverified

findings.issue: A global API key combined with per-identity provider settings could pair credentials with the wrong provider after switching identities.
findings.fix: Shared connection configuration, credential digest consistency guard, explicit replacement/clear on host change and stale snapshot refusal.
findings.evidence: three loopback-provider tests: shared connection persists across role switch/reinit; stale snapshot409 produces zero requests; valid snapshot sends only matching fake key; partial-key-write503 produces zero requests

coverage.identity: Independent chat/memory/task/personality DBs; same identity appearance preserves relationships; archive/restore/delete and last identity guards; stale expected_character_id409; malicious names displayed as text.
coverage.asset: Actual static PNG import, four states, preview not activation, explicit activation, second independent synthetic file/revision rollback, active revision deletion guard, foreign identity asset refusal, metadata removal, resource authorization/path traversal, invalid/oversized/incorrect-field upload preservation.
coverage.asynchrony: Old generation/request reuse, switch during generation or synthesis, deleted profile during synthesis, frontend epoch invalidation, role draft separation, single audio owner and old callbacks, stop/role-switch mouth reset.
coverage.migration: Actual legacy source file SHA256 unchanged after migration, writing migrated DB and reinit; WAL and rollback failure paths in module tests.
coverage.credentials: Only fake test keys and loopback providers; no external account or model calls.
coverage.browser: Chromium at1440/390/360 CSS-pixel widths: no document horizontal overflow; actual file uploads and HTMLAudio advanced; JS runtime errors zero; local screenshot artifacts visually inspected.

No destructive power-loss stress, exhaustive platform fault injection, remote syncing, public sharing, Bilibili/WeChat/Zerolan execution or deployment.

Module cancel_event rollback is tested; closing a browser request may leave a completed inactive revision. Current appearance remains preserved, but socket-disconnect cancellation is not proven.
Another agent/root must report actual host and packaged binary checks separately.
